calls.must: Comes up every year and is learnable in days. Do these first.
calls.should: Appears often but takes longer to learn. Start once the Musts are at basic level.
calls.optional: Only if time is left after the Musts and Shoulds.
calls.skip: Low return for the time left. Leave these questions in the exam.
